g.text: Warning - Storage near capacity on sample-data-pvc, degraded Longhorn volumes, and ImagePullBackOff pod errors.
- PVC sample-data-pvc in namespace sample-ns is critically full at 99.89% usage.
- PVC sample-sftp-server-0 (89.51%) and NFS mount /sample/mount (91.28%) exceed the 80% usage threshold.
- 12 pods in sample-app-ns are stuck Pending due to ImagePullBackOff on node sample-node-1.
- 9 Longhorn volumes are degraded (robustness status 0), affecting sample-svc-a, sample-svc-b, sample-svc-c, and sample-svc-d.
- Top pod resource consumers are sample-processor-engine (10.98 GB RAM) and sample-preprocessor (2.12 CPU cores).
- Expand or clear files on sample-data-pvc and sample-sftp-server-0 PVCs immediately.
- Investigate image registry connectivity and pull credentials for pods failing in sample-app-ns.
- Reconcile degraded Longhorn volume replicas and verify unschedulable status on sample-node-2.
